overview.about: The RBC Heritage is a PGA Tour signature event played at Harbour Town Golf Links on Hilton Head Island, immediately after the Masters. A tight, tree-lined Pete Dye design ending beside the iconic red-and-white lighthouse, it rewards precision over power, and the champion receives a tartan jacket.
overview.nextEvent: The next RBC Heritage is played at Harbour Town Golf Links, Hilton Head Island, South Carolina. The narrow, strategic layout and its famous lighthouse 18th make it a distinctive test in a signature-event field.
